text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliament speaker Berri uncovered names of companies getting illegal benefits from the new customs duties on imported cars.
- Prime Minister Hariri said that the motorways are priority to Lebanon but they need sources of finance.
- President Hrawi received a Libyan invitation to an Arab summit meeting.
- The five-nation group monitoring ceasefire in south Lebanon discussed five complaints from Israel and Lebanon.
- Electricity workers go on one-day strike today to demand pay rise.

- Lebanon's weekly treasury bill issue of June 19 raised 235.7 billion Lebanese pounds, according to finance ministry results. The issue posted a nominal surplus of subscription against maturity of 72 billion pounds.
